He can hot-wire just about everything, from a speeder to a battle cruiser.''"<br />"''Or a manual loadlifter.|Reen Irana and Mander Zuma, referencing Eddey Be'ray's usage of a manual loadlifter|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
A '''manual loadlifter''' was a manually-operated [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used for moving cargo. They had larger spatula-like hands and were cheaper than [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|droid loadlifters]].<ref name="Scourge" />
 
During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|New Republic era]], the [[Bomu Clan]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] criminal family, employed three manual loadlifters at a [[Unidentified Makem Te warehouse|warehouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] ventured to the warehouse to investigate the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] Jedi Knight [[Toro Irana]] and fell [[Lightfight|under fire]] from the Bomu and their [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] lackeys. Be'ray took control of a manual loadlifter and used it against his Bomu assailants.<ref name="Scourge" />
